study type: In vitro experimental study using human placental tissue and trophoblast cell cultures.
exposure: Cell-free fetal DNA (or its agonist poly(dA:dT))
cohort: Placental tissue samples were used from women with severe preeclampsia and matched control women, along with human trophoblast cells and placental explants for in vitro experiments.
finding: Placental IFI16 immunoreactivity and protein levels are significantly increased in women with preeclampsia, and trophoblast cells respond to cell-free fetal DNA through the IFI16 receptor, resulting in the production of the antiangiogenic factors sFlt-1 and sEng.
